guard/30723.htm.text: Captain Roy: Welcome to the Ivory Tower. I am Captain Roy. As a youth I came to this tower to become a Mystic; however, I eventually found that it was not suitable for me. That is why I am doing this currently. Do you have any questions?

links.text: Ask about the monsters around the Ivory Tower.
See the Lord and get the tax rate information.

guard/30723-1.htm.text: Captain Roy: The Ivory Tower has stood here for nigh on a thousand years. It has become quite popular as a place for elites to study the magical arts. There are gates at the north and south of the tower. We guard the tower and its surroundings from a host of threats. The tower has many floors, but …

guard/30723-2.htm.text: Captain Roy: It is said that long ago a meteorite fell to earth right where the Ivory Tower stands today.
